cornerstone.holders: The Cornerstone Investors under the Cornerstone Investment Agreements (incl. CPE Redwood Investment Limited, VERTEXVEST HOLDING PTE. LTD., Hong Kong Mason Electronics Co., Limited, Cambridge Industries Group Telecommunication Limited, CloudAlpha Capital Management Limited, E Fund Management Co., Ltd., E Fund Management (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., Bosera Asset Management (International) Co., Limited, Seven Grand Managers, LLC, 3W Fund Management Limited, Tianhong Asset Management Co., Ltd., Ninety One Asia Pte. Limited, JPMorgan Asset Management (Asia Pacific) Limited, Baring Asset Management (Asia) Limited, Kingboard Investments Limited); aggregate subscription ~34,788,400 Offer Shares (~47.69% of the Global Offering, ~3.24% of total issued share capital at max Offer Price HK$69.88)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that without the prior written consent of our Company, the Joint Sponsors and the Sponsor-Overall Coordinators, it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months following the Listing Date (both days inclusive) (the "Lock-up Period"), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares it has purchased, pursuant to the respective Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of the Cornerstone Investors, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: Period is 'six months following the Listing Date (both days inclusive)'. Taking the Listing Date (2026-09-29) as the inclusive start and a six-month duration with both endpoints inclusive, the window is [2026-09-29, 2027-03-28]; the six-month anniversary 2027-03-29 is the first unrestricted day. Exception: transfers to wholly-owned subsidiaries bound by identical lockup obligations (does not shorten the restricted span).
cornerstone.notes: Standard 6-month cornerstone lockup; no Chapter 18C/18A/19C replacement clauses apply (issuer is a Main Board H-share company under Rule 19A, A+H dual listing). Consent carve-out exists (Company/Joint Sponsors/Sponsor-Overall Coordinators prior written consent) plus wholly-owned-subscriber transfer exception. Closing conditions on p.208; cornerstone investor roster and agreements dated 16-17 Sep 2026 at pp.203-205 and pp.411-413.

controller_6m.holders: Controlling Shareholders (Controlling Shareholders Group): Jinghong Yongtai, Wise Able Investment, Yizhao Investment, Mr. Liu Shaobai, Ms. Huang Xiaofen, Ms. Cheuk Kwan and Mr. Liu Yu (aggregate ~56.01% pre-Global Offering; ~52.21% voting rights immediately post-Global Offering), and the registered holder(s) of the Shares which they beneficially own
controller_6m.full_quote: In accordance with Rule 10.07(1) of the Listing Rules, each of the Controlling Shareholders has undertaken to us and the Stock Exchange that, except pursuant to the Global Offering, it/he/she shall not, and shall procure that the registered holder(s) of the Shares shall not: (a) in the period commencing on the date of the prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the "First Six-Month Period"), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares or securities of the Company in respect of which it/he/she is shown in the prospectus to be the beneficial owners;
controller_6m.basis: Start anchored to the date of the prospectus (prospectus dated 21 September 2026, per accountants'/reporting accountants' letters at pp.280, 360, 368, 382). End anchored to 'the date which is six months from the Listing Date' = 2027-03-29, and disposal on the ending date is restricted ('ending on'), so the endpoint is inclusive. Window: [2026-09-21, 2027-03-29].
controller_6m.notes: Standard Rule 10.07(1)(a) undertaking, no 18C/18A/19C replacement. Carve-out: disposals 'pursuant to the Global Offering'. Supplemental Note 3 to Rule 10.07(2) obligations (pledge/charge notification to the Company and disclosure of chargee disposal indications) run during both six-month periods (p.260). Separately, Rule 10.08 company undertaking (no further share/securities issue for 6 months from Listing Date) also at p.260.

controller_12m.holders: Same Controlling Shareholders (Controlling Shareholders Group): Jinghong Yongtai, Wise Able Investment, Yizhao Investment, Mr. Liu Shaobai, Ms. Huang Xiaofen, Ms. Cheuk Kwan and Mr. Liu Yu, and the registered holder(s) of the Shares which they beneficially own
controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-month Period expires (the "Second Six-Month Period"), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of, or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares or securities referred to in (a) above if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, it/he/she would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder of our Company.
controller_12m.basis: Second Six-Month Period is a 'period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-Month Period expires'. The FSP ends (expires) on 2027-03-29, so the SSP commences 2027-03-29; a six-month duration with both endpoints inclusive runs to 2027-09-28. Conditional restriction: applies only to disposals that would cause the holder to cease to be a Controlling Shareholder. Window: [2027-03-29, 2027-09-28]; the 12-month anniversary 2027-09-29 is the first day on which even a loss-of-control disposal is unrestricted.
controller_12m.notes: Standard Rule 10.07(1)(b) loss-of-control condition; NOT a blanket 12-month disposal ban — non-control-losing disposals become possible from 2027-03-30. Alternative literal reading (SSP commencing the day after FSP expiry, i.e. [2027-03-30, 2027-09-29] inclusive) would push computed_first_free_day to 2027-09-30; we adopt the expiry-date commencement consistent with the prospectus wording. No 18C/18A/19C replacement. Note 3 to Rule 10.07(2) pledge-notice obligations also apply during this period (p.260).
